title: 收集貼紙
question:
你在收集貼紙，每拿到一張就記下它的編號，但不知道最後會拿到幾張，所以要用 vector：拿到一張就 push_back 一張。
請一直輸入貼紙編號，輸入 0 代表結束（0 不算貼紙）。先輸出一共拿到幾張，再把所有編號照拿到的順序輸出在同一行。

en.title: Sticker Collection
en.question:
You collect stickers and write down each number. You do not know how many you will get, so use a vector: push_back each new sticker.
Keep inputting sticker numbers. 0 means stop (0 is not a sticker). Output how many stickers you got, then all the numbers in order on one line.
